download_hf_repo_snapshot: download all files from a Hugging Face Hub repository to a local snapshot folder
download_hf_repo_with_patterns: download a Hugging Face repo snapshot filtering files by allow or ignore patterns
download_hf_repo_specific_revision: download a Hugging Face repo snapshot at a specific branch tag or commit hash
download_hf_repo_local_only: return the local cached snapshot folder path for a Hugging Face repo without downloading
download_hf_dataset_or_space: download all files from a Hugging Face dataset or space repository to a local folder
